title: Shiraishi An — Where They Couldn't Go〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I'm so bored.
Why'd Dad have to go and say that...?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You just performed in a series of tough events. Knowing when to take breaks is important, so no practice tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
I'm sure you know what that means.
No singing tomorrow. Period.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Yeah, I know what he's looking out for us, but no singing...? Not even a peep...?)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Here you go, An.
A refill for your coffee.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh... Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You seem bored.
Are you not sure how to spend your time when you're not allowed to sing?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I mean...
Until now, I'd spend whatever time I had practicing on my own or helping my dad...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But he closed the cafe, which eliminates that option.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Exactly. I'm super bored...
Wait, I know!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What if I worked here, MEIKO?!
Would that be okay?!

rows.Speaker: Miku & MEIKO
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Heya!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Miku, MEIKO, I came to hang out... Wait, huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, Rin, Luka!
Welcome♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
An?!
You're working here now?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I can't practice today, so I thought I could work here instead!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Really?!
Then, we came at a good time♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. Lucky us!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha!
Then, I'll show you to your seats!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay, here's some water.
Do you two know what you wanna order?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, I want my usual blend!
But I'm also pretty hungry, so... I'll have a tuna sandwich and a grilled cheese!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'll have some milk tea and the fruit waffle sandwich!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, coming right up!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: MEIKO, I need Luka's usual blend, a milk tea, a tuna sandwich, a grilled cheese and a fruit waffle sandwich!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Got it. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You seem right at home, An.
I don't think there's anything I need to teach you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: To be fair, I've been doing this forever now. Plus, I always get to see how you and MEIKO run things around here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, I want you to take it easy today♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, I think I will.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, welcome!
Huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Shiraishi?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Come on in, Toya!
I'll show you to your seat! Follow me!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
O-Okay...
Are you helping out here today?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yup! Remember how my dad said we're not allowed to sing today? I was bored out of my mind, so I decided to give back a little by helping out here today.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anyway, you want your usual blend?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, and some cookies.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay!
Oh, that reminds me...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
MEIKO!
The cookies are almost ready, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Just give us a minute, Toya, and you'll get to have some fresh-baked ones. Want me to bring out your coffee when they're ready?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, that sounds nice.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then, I'll take the cookies out of the oven! MEIKO, can you take care of the coffee?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you for being so quick on your feet, An. I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Still... Shiraishi, it feels like it's been so long since you last waited on me like this.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It does feel like it's been forever! After all, we've been spending all our time practicing, and Dad closed our place down!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: An! Can I order some more stuff?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, coming!
Enjoy your visit, Toya!
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Okay, it's getting pretty late.
Why don't you stop here for the day, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huh? Oh, you're right!
I didn't realize what time it was!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I was having so much fun helping you, MEIKO, that I completely lost track...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you for helping me today, An.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, as a small token of my appreciation, I'd like you to have some pancakes on me.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: As a special treat, I'll throw lots of fruits on top, as well as a mix of whipped and custard cream.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, really?! Are you sure?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You were a huge help today, so I'd like to reward you properly with a nice helping of food. So, Miku, let's also take our break now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Woohoo!
Time to dig in♪

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Still... Waiting tables really is nice!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Especially because you get to see firsthand how your customers are liking their food and enjoying their visit!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. That should also be true of the events you perform in.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh... You're right!
If the crowd reacts well, that can be a huge boost of energy...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And seeing them bounce off the walls is seriously the best feeling in the world...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then, you'll need to make that happen during your next event.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I hope you, the others and the audience all get to have lots of fun.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We will! These pancakes are gonna be the fuel I need to keep doing my best!
